description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures a trained NextItNet recommender through the host ModelView interface. It exposes measured metrics and definitions to an interpretation prompt, supporting model improvements selected by macro-average validation HR@10 across four Amazon categories.
motivation: Make diagnostic feedback consistent with the actual model, available data and benchmark objective, while preventing unsupported claims about reviews, ratings or simulated user traits.
implementation_notes: Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Use view.model and the supplied item_emb, log2feats and predict_score interfaces. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B×L tensors. Exclude padding from measurements and read the final nonpadding position of left-padded histories; never use count-1. Restore the model's previous training mode after probing. Return metrics alongside definitions, including sample counts and unavailable-data reasons. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps. Keep one independently trained NextItNet checkpoint per category, consistent with its embedded predictor. Use validation HR@10 for selection; diagnostic proxies do not replace benchmark evaluation. Retain full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
  init(view, device): retain the supplied view and device
  run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
    record view.model.training; enter eval mode
    under no_grad:
      for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
        obtain features through view.log2feats(sequence)
        measure supported score and representation statistics
        exclude padding and invalid target positions
        use the final nonpadding position for sequence-level measurements
      aggregate measurements with explicit denominators
    restore the previous training mode
    return {metrics: measurements, metric_definitions: definitions}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
  include measured metrics, definitions, sample counts and limitations
  request evidence-based interpretations and testable NextItNet changes
  distinguish observations from hypotheses and unavailable information

originality.positive: Connects native diagnostic feedback to a strict family-specific model interface and shared benchmark.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration contract; it specifies no new diagnostic estimator or learning algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Could support reproducible diagnosis-driven architecture and optimization experiments.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic usefulness must be established through validation improvements; proxy measurements alone do not demonstrate recommendation quality.

code_difficulty.positive: The required API and batch structure provide clear implementation boundaries.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding treatment, architecture compatibility, aggregation and predictor consistency require careful verification.
